seo.title: Our Team — OVI Wellness
seo.description: Meet the medical experts and dedicated care team behind your experience at OVI Wellness. Leaders in human performance and concierge patient care.

heroSubheadline: A dedicated team of licensed clinicians and care professionals committed to engineering your optimal vitality and patient experience.

team.name: Dr. Micah Craig, M.D.
team.bio: Internal Medicine physician and Medical Director specializing in regenerative medicine, longevity science, and medical aesthetics, dedicated to evidence-based, whole-person care.
bioFull: Dr. Micah Craig’s journey into medicine began at age five, walking hospital corridors alongside his father, a devoted physician. Those early moments ignited a lifelong calling rooted in healing and human connection. Throughout his undergraduate years, he spent summers on medical mission trips across Africa and Central America — experiences that grounded his commitment to compassionate, service-driven care. After earning his degree, he deepened his scientific foundation with a Master’s in Biochemistry before entering medical school with a clear vision: practice medicine that is both evidence-based and deeply personal.

During his Internal Medicine residency in Denver, Dr. Craig served on the frontlines of the COVID-19 pandemic, navigating the ICU in one of the most demanding periods in modern medicine. That experience sharpened his clinical instincts and revealed the limitations of reactive care — and drove him toward a different approach. He immersed himself in regenerative medicine, longevity science, and aesthetic therapies, pursuing advanced training in ozone therapy, IV therapy, peptide protocols, HBOT, GLP-1 weight management, and medical aesthetics. In 2024, he founded RAVE: Regenerative Aesthetics & Vitality Experts — a clinic built to fuse internal wellness with aesthetic medicine under one integrated roof.

Now serving as Medical Director at OVI Wellness, Dr. Craig brings that same philosophy to our clinic community. He provides medical oversight across all clinical services — from ozone and IV hydration therapy to exosome treatments, peptide protocols, and regenerative aesthetics — ensuring every protocol meets the highest standards of patient-centered, evidence-based care.
team.philosophy: Real transformation happens when you treat the whole person — inside and out. True healing combines rigorous evidence-based science with deep human connection and personalized preventive care.
associations: Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) — Internal Medicine Residency, Denver, CO

team.name: Sean Worix, PA-C
team.bio: Four years of experience across family and integrative medicine, blending evidence-based primary care with advanced strategies in hormone optimization, metabolic health, and longevity-focused medicine.
bioFull: Sean Worix, PA-C, is passionate about helping patients achieve lasting improvements in health through precision medicine, preventive care, and individualized treatment plans. With four years of experience spanning family medicine and integrative medicine, he blends a strong foundation in evidence-based primary care with advanced strategies in hormone optimization, metabolic health, and longevity-focused medicine.

After graduating summa cum laude from West Virginia University with a degree in Exercise Physiology, Sean continued his education at South University–Tampa, earning his Master of Science in Physician Assistant Studies, also summa cum laude. His background in human performance and clinical medicine allows him to develop comprehensive treatment plans that address the underlying drivers of health while helping patients improve energy, body composition, cognitive performance, and overall well-being.

At OVI Wellness, Sean is committed to delivering personalized, compassionate care built on scientific evidence, transparency, and long-term partnerships—empowering every patient to optimize not only how they feel today, but how they age for decades to come.
team.philosophy: True health optimization isn't about chasing laboratory values—it's about restoring function, improving quality of life, and helping patients perform at their highest potential through personalized, evidence-based medicine.
associations: Master of Science in Physician Assistant Studies (MSPAS) — South University (Summa Cum Laude)
B.S. in Exercise Physiology — West Virginia University (Summa Cum Laude)
National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA)

team.name: Kaylyn Busciglio, MA
team.bio: Dedicated Medical Assistant providing attentive clinical patient care, vital signs assessment, and diagnostic intake at OVI Wellness.
bioFull: Kaylyn Busciglio brings a warm, compassionate, and detail-oriented approach to patient care as a Medical Assistant at OVI Wellness. Working closely alongside our medical director and clinical team, Kaylyn is dedicated to creating a reassuring, comfortable environment where patients feel supported through every step of their visit.

With specialized hands-on training in patient intake, vital signs assessment, and clinical patient care, Kaylyn plays an essential role in ensuring every patient is thoroughly prepared and monitored throughout their appointment.
Her attentive bedside manner, clinical precision, and genuine dedication to patient wellness ensure that every individual visiting OVI Wellness receives the highest standard of individualized care.
team.philosophy: Compassionate care is at the heart of healing. My priority is to make sure every patient feels comfortable, informed, and truly cared for during every treatment.

team.name: Neha Parikh
team.bio: Dedicated Office Manager overseeing practice operations, concierge patient coordination, and scheduling at OVI Wellness, committed to ensuring every patient receives attentive, seamless, and personalized care.
bioFull: As Office Manager at OVI Wellness, Neha Parikh is the cornerstone of our day-to-day clinic operations and patient experience. With a genuine passion for hospitality, organizational excellence, and client-centered service, she ensures that every patient feels welcomed, supported, and valued from the moment they contact our practice.

Neha coordinates patient scheduling, seamless visit logistics, and practice administration with meticulous attention to detail. Working hand-in-hand with Dr. Craig and our clinical providers, she bridges clinical excellence with personalized concierge service, ensuring your wellness journey is frictionless, comfortable, and tailored to your needs.
Her dedication to exceptional communication and warm patient advocacy makes her an indispensable guide for new and returning patients alike as they navigate their personalized optimization protocols.
team.philosophy: Exceptional care begins before you ever step into the treatment room. My goal is to ensure every patient feels heard, valued, and completely supported at every step of their wellness journey.

team.name: Erica Valdes
team.bio: Leading marketing, brand strategy, patient education, and community outreach at OVI Wellness, connecting people with the life-changing science of personalized longevity medicine.
bioFull: Erica Valdes leads marketing strategy and brand communications at OVI Wellness, connecting individuals seeking optimal vitality with our world-class medical team and advanced therapies.

With deep expertise in healthcare brand storytelling, digital growth, patient education, and community partnerships, Erica crafts authentic campaigns that highlight the transformative science behind our regenerative protocols. She is committed to making complex health optimization concepts clear, inspiring, and accessible to our patients.

Working in close collaboration with our clinical and operations leadership, Erica ensures that the OVI Wellness mission — delivering individualized, doctor-led longevity medicine — resonates across Florida and beyond.
team.philosophy: Empowering people to take control of their health begins with education, clarity, and trust. Our mission is to share the transformative potential of personalized wellness so more people can live with vitality.

team.name: Virgil Valdes
team.bio: Founder & Principal of Optimal Vitality Institute, LLC, focused on improving healthcare systems and operations to build strong foundations for clinicians and elevate patient care.
bioFull: Virgil Valdes is the Founder & Principal of Optimal Vitality Institute, LLC. focused on improving existing healthcare systems and wellness programs.

His background is in healthcare operations, practice management, and marketing — building structure around licensed clinicians so they can focus on patient care. At OVI, he oversees the systems and day-to-day foundation of the practice.
team.philosophy: Good care depends on good systems. My work has always been about strengthening those systems so medical professionals can help people live healthier lives.
